title: Data Analyst
description:
Ethos Talent is partnering with an established business to recruit a Data Analyst on an initial three-month contract.

This is a great opportunity for an organised and analytical individual to support the business with reporting, data management and commercial administration.

The Role

  • Produce and analyse reports covering sales, profitability, stock and operational performance.
  • Maintain accurate commercial data, including pricing, sales records and customer information.
  • Support data analysis, reporting improvements and wider business projects.
  • Work with internal teams to ensure accurate information across business systems.
  • Provide general administrative and operational support to commercial and management teams.

About You

  • Previous experience in a Data Analyst, Commercial Support, Business Support or similar role.
  • Strong Excel skills with experience analysing data and producing reports.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
  • Confident communicating with stakeholders across different departments.
  • Experience using ERP systems, ideally NetSuite, would be advantageous.
  • Available immediately or at short notice.

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established business and make an immediate contribution within a varied, hands-on role.

If you are interested then please Apply Now.
